body: Hard set 0/15. Missing tests visible in records: negative net worth (Jet, Kingfisher), interest cover <1x (IL&FS), ALM mismatch (DHFL, SVB), payouts from borrowed money (Evergrande, GE), group holdco debt (Zee, Future). Proposal: a graded solvency set, pre-registered and back-tested on a point-in-time universe with dead companies before use.
title: No hard or graded rule caught any of 15 leverage blow-ups pre-T (Jet, IL&FS, Adani Ent., Future, Zee, Unitech, Suzlon-2008, Kingfisher, SVB, Lehman, Evergrande, GE, Credit Suisse, Paytm, PC Jeweller) except pledge on 3
